# `<util/log.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Userspace leveled logging: LOG_DEBUG()..LOG_ERROR() go through LogWrite() with a run-time minimum level.

The kernel uses <core/log.h> instead.

```c
#include <util/log.h>
```

## Constants

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="log_debug"></a>`LOG_DEBUG(tag, fmt, ...)` |  | Logs at DEBUG level under `tag`. |
| <a id="log_info"></a>`LOG_INFO(tag, fmt, ...)` |  | Logs at INFO level under `tag`. |
| <a id="log_warn"></a>`LOG_WARN(tag, fmt, ...)` |  | Logs at WARN level under `tag`. |
| <a id="log_error"></a>`LOG_ERROR(tag, fmt, ...)` |  | Logs at ERROR level under `tag`. |

## Enumerations

### `LogLevel` { #loglevel }

Log severity, lowest first.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `LOG_LEVEL_TRACE` | `0` | Very verbose tracing. |
| `LOG_LEVEL_DEBUG` | `1` | Debugging detail. |
| `LOG_LEVEL_INFO` | `2` | Normal operation. |
| `LOG_LEVEL_WARN` | `3` | Something unexpected but recoverable. |
| `LOG_LEVEL_ERROR` | `4` | An operation failed. |
| `LOG_LEVEL_FATAL` | `5` | The program cannot continue. |

## Functions

### `LogSetLevel` { #logsetlevel }

```c
void LogSetLevel(LogLevel min_level);
```

Sets the lowest level LogWrite() prints.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `min_level` | in | Messages below this level are dropped. |

### `LogGetLevel` { #loggetlevel }

```c
LogLevel LogGetLevel(void);
```

Returns the lowest level LogWrite() prints.

**Returns:** The current minimum level.

### `LogWrite` { #logwrite }

```c
void LogWrite(LogLevel level, const char *tag, const char *fmt,...);
```

Logs one message: to logsvc if it is running, else to stdout as level, uptime in ms, optional tag and message.

The first call looks for /svc/log and keeps the session; if logsvc is absent the call prints and looks again at most once a second. Messages longer than 255 characters are cut.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `level` | in | Severity; dropped if below the minimum level. |
| `tag` | in | Short source name shown in parentheses, or NULL. |
| `fmt` | in | printf-style format. |

### `LogShutdown` { #logshutdown }

```c
void LogShutdown(void);
```

Closes the session with logsvc, if there is one.

Called when the program exits.
